optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
)
SELECT d_year, brand_id, brand, sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT dt.d_year,
           i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
           MAX(i.i_brand) AS brand,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY dt.d_year, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) DESC, i.i_brand_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN filtered_item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_moy = 11
    ) AS dt ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY dt.d_year, i.i_brand_id
) AS ranked
WHERE rn <= 100
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
